Reviewed the record continuation sender and shared responsive controls after the pre-push catch. Record sends now use randomCorrelationId, which works when plain HTTP omits crypto.randomUUID. With that API removed, all three host/direct/relay send cases failed before the fix; all seven record cases pass after it (15.51 seconds). Existing delivery keys, outbox fencing, request scope and current-connection checks are unchanged. Shared chat touch sizing uses its existing 768px/coarse block; Task-room buttons consume the shared touch-floor token while preserving their desktop floor. Record hover actions follow the shared reader compact-state attribute inside the existing hover block; member header declarations retain their 768px breakpoint in the shared Project sheet. No CSS baseline or scanner exemption was added. The DOM row selector only moved into its querySelectorAll call; it is not UI copy and its bytes are unchanged. Vocabulary allowlist lines moved with their existing exact fixtures; a new branch-local note was corrected to the canonical saved Station wording without changing its claims. Existing conversation ownership explanations remain valid; browser visual recheck is recorded separately.
